d: Road to Gymkhana Grid is a feature documentary following eight world-class drivers' journey to South Africa to compete in the world drifting championship event.
A pink, air-cooled, 1973 Porsche 911 RS is upgraded with a custom built engine, new paint, and new wheels and tires.
A slow and outdated 1959 Mercedes Benz 180 D is modified with a bargain budget to include new wheels and an American V8 muscle motor.
A 1972 Ford Track T Roadster is incomplete and needs Titan Restorarion s finishing touch with its flathead V8 engine.
Franco continues to claw back points and has a nail biting wait to find out if he has won ‘Rookie of the Year'. Will he be riding again next year?
Mike and Nik review the 2021 Ford Mustang Mach-E. Nik predicts the Genesis G80 will challenge German manufacturers. He showcases the 2021 Mini GP and Polestar 2. Mike explores the 2021 Infiniti QX50.

Nik experiences Mercedes-Benz's concept for Avatar 2. Both Nik and Mike unveil top-performing cars for value. Nik reviews the 2021 Kia Telluride and 2021 Lexus IS. Mike introduces the Ford Mach-E 1400.
Nik praises the 2021 Audi e-tron Sportback. Mike talks about the return of the coupe SUV with the Infiniti QX55. Nik tests the Lamborghini Huracan EVO and explores the 2021 hybrid Wrangler 4XE.
